summary: Withdraw an unfinished person handoff from the requester CLI

replay.detail: Uses the existing durable handoff-return transition without changing projection or replay.

schema.detail: No new replicated claim, database migration or client action is added.

rules.detail: The handing-agent, current exact note, attempt, live-generation and unclaimed-step fences remain authoritative.

compatibility.detail: Adds work handoff withdraw STEP --reason TEXT --as AGENT with optional exact --message and --idempotency-key. Existing transfer syntax is preserved; person actors cannot use withdrawal.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond normal client replacement.

manual.detail: No configuration conversion or data repair is required.

recovery.detail: The existing disposition record and retry key recover accepted withdrawals after later work; stale notes are refused without completion.
